editor.name: Name
editor.name_hint: Shown in logs and in the messages sent to your scripts.

type_desc.rsync: Pick a source, a target and what to copy.
type_desc.immich: Knows the Immich folder layout and the right order.

editor.type_note: The type lives in {{path}}. Its settings are the ones below, and its steps are listed in Preview plan.
editor.source_hint: Opened read-only. HomeBackup never writes to a source.
editor.mode_hint: Database dumps, profile and uploads are always copied in full. Only the library is limited to the window.
editor.thumbs: Also copy thumbnails and encoded video
editor.thumbs_hint: Immich can rebuild these, so they are off by default.
editor.delete_label: Delete files on the target that are gone from the source
editor.delete_hint: Only inside the folders that are synced. Older data on the drive is never touched. Run a dry run before turning this on.
editor.tz_note: The time zone follows Home Assistant.
editor.hooks_hint: Home Assistant scripts to call. Empty means the default from Settings.
editor.folders_note: Later runs only touch these folders. The first run copies everything.
editor.overlap_body: Both write to {{dest}}. If they run at the same time, the later one fails with a conflict. Keep their schedules apart.
